description: Inside a transitive ZF model containing the forcing data, the stated recursions and set constructions produce the same check names, canonical filter name, pair and ordered-pair names, refined union names, name-rank ordinals and Cohen name as in the ambient universe. They remain in the model when their parameters do; finite inactive-attachment names do also. Full internal ZF recursion, definability and model closure are unencoded, so this assertion is unbound.
